report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - San Martin County Water District (Report Date 05/01/2026)

sources_described: Well water: Well 4300542-003 (the Camping World Well), Sycamore Ave, San Martin (page 1). The source water assessment found no contaminants exceeding standards but considers the source most vulnerable to low-density septic systems and chemical/petroleum processing/storage. Water is purchased for short periods during emergencies from California American Water (West San Martin) (page 2).

extraction_notes: Older State CCR template filled by the district (Report Date 05/01/2026, monitoring period January 2025 - December 2025). Printed pages equal PDF pages (1-4). Table 4 stacks MCL/[MRDL] and PHG/(MCLG)/[MRDLG] in one cell; these are transcribed as printed, e.g. '1.00 [N/A]' and '2.00 (N/A) [N/A]'. Many results are triennial 2023-2024 data (lead/copper 06/2023, sodium/hardness/barium/fluoride/TDS/chloride/color/iron/sulfate 04/2023, chlorine 12/2024, hexavalent chromium 11/2024, specific conductance 12/2024); sample_year records the printed date. Page 4 narrative states 1,2,3-trichloropropane (Oct 2024), asbestos in the distribution system (Feb 2024), 33 VOCs including MTBE (Apr 2023) and 15 SOCs (Jan 2020) were all 'Non Detected' - these are not tabulated so no entries were created. The EAR portal URL serves the PDF directly.
